title: DetectionFinding
description: One detector result for one content part of an interaction (opt-in content capture, PRP-99). A fragment: it has no schema_version of its own and is embedded by RedactedContent (and, in later items, the interaction record). It carries a category, counts and offsets into the redacted text, never the matched text. Rule JSON Schema expresses with if/then: a credential category (CredentialCategory) requires action `replaced`; a credential can never be kept. Pydantic ignores if/then (ADR-0004), so consumers validate against the JSON Schema.

detector_id.description: Detector that produced the finding (lowercase slug).

detector_version.description: Detector version, semantic version without prefix.

count.description: Number of matches of this category in the part.

action.description: What redaction did with the matches: `replaced` with a placeholder, or `kept` as written (only for non-credential categories a capture policy keeps).

spans.description: Character offsets of the matches into the redacted text of the part. Offsets only; never the matched text.

allOf.description: A credential category is always replaced, never kept.

detected_category.title: DetectedCategory
detected_category.description: Kind of sensitive content a detector found; open-ended: readers must tolerate unknown values. The first eight are credential categories (CredentialCategory).

credential_category.title: CredentialCategory
credential_category.description: Categories that are credentials. Closed set: always replaced, never kept, and never listed in a capture policy's kept categories.

part_kind.title: ContentPartKind
part_kind.description: Which part of an interaction a piece of content is.
